L1 compose-computed.notes: ComposeList's start list matches Compose's two branches case by case, so the lists agree.

L2 encode-computed.notes: EncodeList's early test HasModifier or HasPlain equals Encode's first two branches.

M1 modifier-steps.notes: Mods on one entry matches the English, including the nonempty rule for plus and first-occurrence removal for minus.

M2 modifier-sequence.notes: Mods folds entries in order, so concatenation composes.

C1 modifiers-over-below.notes: A nonempty all-modifier layer over a selection below gives Mods(below, es) by Compose's first branch.

C2 plain-list.notes: A plain entry makes the layer not all-modifier with plains nonempty, so Compose is Mods over the plain names.

C3 modifiers-over-defaults.notes: With no selection below and only modifiers, the start list is the defaults, giving Mods(defaults, es).

C4 empty-is-no-tools.notes: Empty entries give an empty plain list and Mods of nothing, which is the empty list.

B1 no-duplicates.notes: The premise is stronger than needed but sound, since ModsNodup preserves the nodup start list.

E1 modifiers-kept.notes: The first Encode branch returns Holds of the chosen list when a modifier is present.

E2 plain-layer-stays-plain.notes: A plain entry in current makes it not all-modifier, so Encode returns Holds of the chosen list.

E3 round-trip.notes: All four Encode outcomes unfold to the chosen names in order, including the Nothing case where base equals the plains.

E4 relative-when-reproducible.notes: Unfolding Encode with an all-modifier current gives Nothing when delta is empty and Holds of delta otherwise.

E5 plain-when-order-differs.notes: When the delta modifiers cannot reproduce the plains, Encode returns Holds of the chosen list for any current.
